scope: Application design approval only; original source/review decisions and scientific/operational limitations remain unchanged.
original_human_message: Je valide MS01–MS08 et C1–C4. Enregistre mes décisions, puis implémente le parcours MabSelect avec les tests MC01–MC12. Garde v03 et les 16 notes inchangés. Aucun LLM, API payante, commit ni push.

decisions.statement: Use a separate MabSelect cleaning entry point; do not extend the Sepharose pressure-trigger claim to MabSelect
Distinguish family-unknown, plain MabSelect, SuRe and SuRe LX; allow recipe cards only for the three exact identities initially
Keep A1–A4 separate, minimum contact and immediate wash intact, with no automatic treatment selection
Show the additional restricted block only for SuRe/SuRe LX in the reviewed precipitated/denatured context; do not concatenate or rank it
Keep detergent versus solvents, and ethanol versus 2-propanol, as separate alternatives, with both precautions attached
Unknown/mixed context yields clarification, not a diagnosis or a combined recipe; bounded missing-parameter messages retain available guidance
Reuse Q05/Q06/N06/N07/Q09 only within their entire scoped bundles and original reservations; source flags and original human messages remain unchanged
Implement incrementally only after this contract review: no v03 modification, no source publication, no new parser/model/database or expanded scientific claim
Distinguish the exact unsuffixed MabSelect product from the MabSelect family with unknown variant; unknown exact identity gets headings/context and clarification only.
For SuRe/SuRe LX, display general alternatives and the restricted sequence in two separate blocks, with no preselection, ranking or implied succession.
Unknown or mixed context requires exploration of one category at a time, without a confirmed diagnosis and without merging procedures.
pH 7.0–8.0 applies to the following binding-buffer wash, with no automatic adjustment; absent flow, pressure, solvent duration or CV-to-mL parameters stay unspecified within the selected block.
